title: Irrigation Safety Plan
description: Free Irrigation Safety Plan template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, routine checks, approval & sign-off.

Hazards And Controls

HazardControl measure
Electrocution from pumps, panels and overhead linesRCD protection, qualified electrician, lock- out, keep pipes and booms clear of power lines
Drowning in canals, ponds and tanksFencing, signs, rescue equipment, no solitary work
Entanglement in pump shafts and drivesGuards and lock-out before maintenance
Pressurised pipes and fittings failurePressure ratings, inspection, release pressure before repairs
Fertigation and chemigation chemicalsBackflow prevention, labelling, PPE, interlocks
Slips and unstable ground at banks and channelsSafe access, footwear, drainage

Routine Checks

☐ Electrical equipment weatherproof and earthed

☐ Guards fitted on pumps and drives

☐ Backflow preventers tested

☐ Warning signs at open water and treated areas

☐ Workers trained in electrical safety and emergency response

☐ Lock-out of power and pressure before maintenance
